ImagePart.load() fails when opening documents with images

#### Description

When opening a Word document that contains images, the `ImagePart.load()` method raises an error due to attempting to decode binary image data as UTF-8 text.

#### Steps/Code to Reproduce

```python
from docx import Document
from docx.package import Package

# Try to open a document containing images
package = Package.open('document_with_images.docx')
image_parts = package.image_parts  # This will fail
```

The error occurs when the package tries to load image parts during document opening. Image data is binary and cannot be decoded as UTF-8 text, but the current implementation attempts to do so.

#### Expected Behavior

Documents containing images should open successfully and image parts should be accessible without errors.

#### Actual Behavior

Opening documents with images raises a `UnicodeDecodeError` when trying to decode binary image data as UTF-8.
</issue>
